dct_title_s: Lyon County, Iowa, 1938, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol BKE; form of individual image numbering: BKE-1-[number], BKE-2-[number], BKE-3-[number], or BKE-4-[number]. "Date of completion Ocotober 21, 1938". Flown by Iowa Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
